findings.title: The existing four-dimension `downsize` API has been removed by Ruby method redefinition
findings.body: Ruby does not overload methods. The new definition at line 149 replaces the preceding `downsize(from, to, max_width, max_height, opts={})` definition, so callers using the previously supported width/height form now receive `ArgumentError: wrong number of arguments`. The preceding definition is therefore dead code. Keep a single implementation that accepts both forms (or update all existing callers and intentionally change the contract).

findings.title: Client-side upload validation no longer honors configured attachment and image limits
findings.body: This replaces `max_image_size_kb`/`max_attachment_size_kb` with a hard-coded 10 MB limit for every upload type. Sites with a smaller attachment limit will now let users select files that the server subsequently rejects, and sites configured to allow files larger than 10 MB will have those uploads blocked in the browser. Automatic image reduction does not justify applying a fixed image-sized limit to non-image attachments; retain the configured limit for attachments and make any larger-image allowance explicit and consistent with server behavior.
